hero.badge: AI Sales Assistant for Cambodian Sellers
hero.description: Your AI-powered shop assistant that understands Khmer, English, and romanized Khmer — replying to customers 24/7 on Facebook, Telegram, TikTok, and your website.

features.description: Apsara handles customer conversations so you can focus on growing your business.
features.f1Desc: Understands Khmer Unicode script, romanized Khmer (like 'bong thlai ponman?'), and English — and replies naturally in whichever language your customer uses.
features.f2Desc: Connect Facebook Messenger, Telegram, TikTok Shop, or embed a chat widget directly on your website. One Apsara for every channel.
features.f3Desc: Add your products once. Apsara knows every price, description, and stock status — and sells them automatically without you lifting a finger.
features.f4Desc: Never miss a customer message again. Apsara replies instantly, day or night, weekday or holiday — even while you sleep.
features.f5Desc: Create and track orders directly from conversations. Delivery address, notes, and order status — all in one place.
features.f6Desc: See your total products, active customers, open conversations, and orders at a glance. Know your business in seconds.

howItWorks.description: No technical knowledge needed. Set up your AI sales assistant in minutes.
howItWorks.s1Desc: Create your product catalog with names, prices, descriptions, and stock quantities. Apsara learns your entire inventory automatically.
howItWorks.s2Desc: Connect a customer on any platform — Facebook, Telegram, TikTok, or your website — and start a conversation in seconds.
howItWorks.s3Desc: Send any customer message and Apsara instantly replies in their language — Khmer, English, or romanized Khmer — with accurate product info and pricing.

cta.description: Join hundreds of Cambodian sellers using Apsara to handle customer messages automatically — in Khmer, English, and romanized Khmer.

footer.description: AI-powered sales assistant for Cambodian online sellers. Handles your customer conversations in Khmer, English, and romanized Khmer — 24/7.
